digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler status mapping (outbound and inbound)
propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; it must become config-driven with per-project overlays via S1 MappingLayer resolution, falling back to built-in if no config exists.
Unmapped statuses must drift (omit status field in mutation, leaving Jira unchanged) rather than coerce or fail, with deduped drift alerts per-status per-process.
Config remaps and status collapses must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels, with labels stamped iff the Jira target differs from the built-in canonical name.
Inbound recovery of rebar-status labels must use a shared derived vocabulary (not a divergent literal) covering all local status values the stamp rule can emit.
Fetcher known-set and preflight_status_mapping must tolerate config-only/remapped Jira status names declared in the mapping config.
Outbound mapper must resolve the per-project effective status map from repo_root (not CWD) and thread it through CREATE and UPDATE mutations, including label diff computation.
